reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Timothy Jackson
reviews.text: Cash Plumbing is amazing ! Is always on time , the same day, very reasonable pricing, and an honest company! If you ever need plumbing needs around the Fayetteville area please don’t go any further than Cash plumbing because they will save you time and Cash!

reviews.author: Diane Rzepka
reviews.text: Where do I start. He was awesome. My exterior was leaking from under my siding. Randy came out the same day and determined it was the laundry line. Got everything replaced, and I was so relieved he didn't charge me an arm and a leg. What he charged me equates to most companies charging just to diagnose, and he did it all for less. He discussed anything else I wanted to know, like getting a tankless water heater and installing a shower for my dogs. He said he treats his clients like he's working on his own house, and it shows. Plus, he showed the same day.

reviews.author: Savonnie Washington
reviews.text: Randy was awesome! Came in and got the job done. So nice, kind and down to earth. Felt like i was talking to one of my cousins! Definitely saving his number in my phone if we ever need this kind of service again. Price was affordable!
